skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and role of brands
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the legal and marketing perspectives of brand-related terminology. Grasp foundational knowledge about brand management for businesses.
Understand the steps in developing a brand strategy, execution of the strategy, and brand management over time.
Understand and apply skills to build brand value orientation, positioning, characteristics, and image.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing market environment impacts on brand management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the effects of market environment factors on brand management, principles, and processes for building brand strategies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying knowledge and skills to manage brand communication activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge and skills to manage brand communication activities and brand management over time at a specific business/organization.
Equip students with self-management, responsibility, independent work, and teamwork skills.
